lost_facts.evidence: Raw tool call (message index 145 of the full rollout JSON) shows the shipped implementation: `def remaining_cooldown_seconds(tracker, now): horizon = getattr(tracker,'throttle_cooldown_until',0.0) or 0.0; return max(0.0, horizon - now)` -- no round().
